```yaml
name: Benchmark v2 Set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: 'Number of tasks to run (1-10)'
        required: true
        default: '2'
        type: number

jobs:
  generate-tasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      task_ids: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.task_ids }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Generate top reward tasks
        id: generate
        run: echo "::set-output name=task_ids::$(bun scripts/generate-v2-top-reward-tasks.ts | jq -r '.[] | .id' | tr '\n' ',')"
      
      - name: Commit generated tasks
        run: |
          git add data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json
          git commit -m "Update v2 top reward tasks"
          git push origin main

  benchmark:
    needs: generate-tasks
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.agent }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent: ['ubuntu-latest', 'macos-latest', 'windows-latest']
        model: ['gpt-3.5-turbo', 'gpt-4']
        timeout-minutes: [10, 20]
        task-id: ${{ join(needs.generate-tasks.outputs.task_ids, ',') }}
        max-parallel: [1]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          npx ts-node benchmarks/v2/run-benchmark.ts --task-id ${{ matrix.task-id }} --model ${{ matrix.model }} --timeout-minutes ${{ matrix.timeout-minutes }}

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: benchmark-results-${{ matrix.task-id }}-${{ matrix.model }}-${{ matrix.timeout-minutes }}
          path: results/${{ matrix.task-id }}-${{ matrix.model }}-${{ matrix.timeout-minutes }}.json
```
